config.title: Chat Model Provider for Amazon Bedrock
config.profile.description: AWS profile name in `~/.aws/config` (SSO supported). Required.
config.region.description: AWS region, for example `us-west-2`. Leave empty to use the region set in the profile.
config.modelFilter.description: Which models to list in the Chat model picker.
config.inferenceScope.description: Which cross-Region inference profile to use. Requests are processed only within the chosen scope.
config.inferenceScope.geo: Geographic profile (for example `us.` or `eu.`, based on your region). Data stays within that geography. Models that only offer a global profile are hidden.
config.inferenceScope.global: Global profile. Requests may be processed in any AWS Region worldwide. Falls back to the geographic profile when a model has no global profile.
config.usageResetDay.description: Day of the month (1–31) when the token usage totals reset. If a month has fewer days, the reset happens on its last day.
config.usageResetHour.description: Hour (UTC, 0–23) when the token usage totals reset.
config.customPricing.description: Your own prices in USD per 1M tokens, keyed by model ID. These override the downloaded prices (the public AWS price list, then the price tables on AWS model cards). `cacheRead` and `cacheWrite` are optional prompt cache prices; without them, costs for requests that read or write the prompt cache are not estimated. Custom prices have no long-context tier, so costs for requests above a model's long-context threshold are not estimated. Example: `{ "openai.gpt-6-astra": { "input": 5, "output": 20 } }`
